summary: Reviewed RendererPaginationTest.php and phpunit.xml. All five combinatorial pagination states are correctly covered for both DefaultRenderer and Bootstrap5Renderer (12 test methods). Code is clean, properly isolated, and follows all project conventions. PHPStan tuple return types are used correctly in helper methods. Aria-label assertions accurately close the WP-002 coverage gap. comments.note: The IPP tests (States 3, 5, aria-label) call setItemsPerPageOptions() but not setItemsPerPageURLTemplate(). The JS generated is 'window.location.href = null.replace(...)' — not a test failure (PHP doesn't throw), but makes the setup silently incomplete. Adding an explicit setItemsPerPageURLTemplate('/items?ipp={IPP}') call would make the test intent self-documenting.

Asymmetric negative assertions in State 3 tests are actually correct: DefaultRenderer negative-asserts '<nav' while Bootstrap5Renderer negative-asserts 'class="pagination"'. Because Bootstrap5Renderer wraps its <ul class="pagination"> in a <nav>, checking for 'class="pagination"' is the correct discriminator. No change needed — mentioning for documentation clarity.
No observations beyond the above — code is clean, properly structured, and consistent with project conventions.
